description: DB-specific column -> (quantity_kind, unit) mapping owned by SiennaGridDB. Consumed by scripts/generate_unit_registry.py together with SiennaSchemas Core/units.json (the vocabulary source of truth) to seed the unit_conventions table. Every (quantity_kind, unit) here must exist in units.json allowed_units. Rows may carry an optional discriminator_column/discriminator_value pair for columns whose unit depends on a sibling column's value (e.g. hydro_reservoirs.level_data_type). Cost JSON blobs are registered as JSON-path column names (operation_cost.fixed, ...). The five attributes.* rows are attribute-name conventions, not physical columns.
